source_policy.rule: Every scoring rule must be backed by a 'Kurallar' or 'Uygulama talimati' item of a knowledge-base document (source.doc + source.section). Items listed under a document's DOGRULANMADI section and rules without a document ('SEO folklore') are never scoring rules. All paths are portable: source.doc is relative to the knowledge-base root named by knowledge_base, and document is relative to the plugin root; no machine-specific absolute path is stored.

critical_cap.applies_when: any rule with level=critical has state 0

notes: Weights do not have to total 100; the formula normalises.
The critical cap limits the band, it does not change the formula. UI must show the cap note.
Median of post scores may be displayed for information only and never feeds the score.

title.en: Site is open to search engines

site.measures: wp_options.blog_public, rendered <meta name='robots'> on the home page, 'Disallow: /' under 'User-agent: *' in /robots.txt

recommendation.en: Turn search engine visibility back on. The site currently sends noindex on every page, so nothing can be indexed until this is fixed.
recommendation.tr: Arama motoru gorunurlugunu yeniden acin. Site su anda her sayfada noindex gonderiyor; duzeltilene kadar hicbir sayfa dizine giremez.

site.measures: GET /robots.txt -> status code, Content-Type, body byte size

recommendation.en: Serve a valid robots.txt: plain text, from the site root, under 500 KiB.
recommendation.tr: Gecerli bir robots.txt sunun: site kokunden, duz metin olarak, 500 KiB altinda.
recommendation.target: hosting / server (WPSeoKit only adds the Sitemap line)

site.measures: body of /robots.txt; HEAD request to the URL on the Sitemap line

checks.expect: at least one 'Sitemap:' line with an absolute URL (scheme + host)

partial.formula: line exists but relative or not 200 => 0.5

recommendation.en: Add a Sitemap line with the full sitemap URL to robots.txt.
recommendation.tr: robots.txt'ye tam sitemap adresini iceren bir Sitemap satiri ekleyin.

site.measures: GET sitemap URL, XML parse, root element, first 5 <loc> values

checks.expect: root urlset or sitemapindex and every <loc> an absolute https URL

recommendation.en: Regenerate the sitemap and confirm it answers with XML and absolute URLs.
recommendation.tr: Sitemap'i yeniden uretin; XML olarak yanit verdigini ve adreslerin mutlak oldugunu dogrulayin.

site.measures: first 50 <loc> values in document order; HEAD each one, redirects not followed

checks.expect: 200 for every URL; any 3xx/4xx/5xx counts as failure

recommendation.en: Fix the sitemap URLs that return a redirect or an error; list only URLs that answer 200.
recommendation.tr: Sitemap'te yonlendirme veya hata donen adresleri duzeltin; yalniz 200 donen adresleri listeleyin.

checks.read: share of URLs covered by one single timestamp

site.pass_condition: distinct ratio == 1.0 and no single timestamp covers more than 90%

partial.formula: distinct / sampled; force 0 when one timestamp covers > 90%

recommendation.en: Write each URL's real content-modification date into lastmod instead of the generation time.
recommendation.tr: lastmod alanina uretim anini degil, her adresin gercek icerik degisiklik tarihini yazin.

site.measures: GET http://{host}/ (redirect code and target), GET https://{host}/ with certificate verification on, HTTPS response Location header

checks.expect: 301 or 308 to the same host over https

site.environment_note: On local/staging hosts a self-signed certificate fails check 2. Show an environment note and re-measure on the live host; do not silently treat staging as healthy.

recommendation.en: Serve the site over HTTPS with a valid certificate and redirect HTTP to HTTPS once, without going back to HTTP.
recommendation.tr: Siteyi gecerli sertifikayla HTTPS uzerinden sunun; HTTP'yi tek adimda HTTPS'e yonlendirin ve geri http'ye donmeyin.

title.en: Every page outputs its own canonical

site.measures: head of the home page plus 3 URLs picked deterministically from the sitemap

checks.expect: exactly one link rel=canonical, absolute, equal to the page URL

recommendation.en: Emit rel=canonical on every page with the page's own absolute URL.
recommendation.tr: Her sayfada, sayfanin kendi mutlak adresini tasiyan rel=canonical etiketi basın.
recommendation.target: WPSeoKit > Settings > General (core rel_canonical is disabled)

title.en: Home page Open Graph set is complete
title.tr: Ana sayfa Open Graph seti tam

site.measures: head of the home page; HEAD request for og:image

checks.expect: absolute URL equal to the canonical/page URL

recommendation.en: Add the missing Open Graph tags; a homepage needs og:title, og:type, og:image and og:url.
recommendation.tr: Eksik Open Graph etiketlerini ekleyin; ana sayfada og:title, og:type, og:image ve og:url zorunlu.

site.measures: Organization (or LocalBusiness) node in the home page JSON-LD

checks.expect: non-empty absolute URL of the site

recommendation.en: Fill the organization name, URL and logo in the schema settings.
recommendation.tr: Schema ayarlarinda kurum adini, adresini ve logosunu doldurun.

title.en: No unsupported or wrong schema nodes

site.measures: JSON-LD on the home page, one post and one category page

checks.expect: no FAQPage (Google stopped showing it on 7 May 2026)
no Product node on a list page
no SearchAction (sitelinks search box was retired)

recommendation.en: Remove the structured-data nodes Google no longer supports here and keep ratings off your own organization.
recommendation.tr: Google'in artik desteklemedigi yapisal veri dugumlerini kaldirin ve kurumun kendi dugumunde puanlama tutmayin.

site.measures: GET a random 12-character path that cannot exist

checks.expect: 404 (410 also accepted); 200 with a 'not found' message is a soft 404 => fail

recommendation.en: Return HTTP 404 for missing pages instead of a page that says 'not found' with a 200 status.
recommendation.tr: Olmayan sayfalar icin 200 durumuyla 'bulunamadi' diyen sayfa yerine HTTP 404 dondurun.
recommendation.target: WPSeoKit > 404 log / Redirects (theme template fix may be manual)

site.measures: GET /feed/: status, XML parse, first 5 <item><link>, first 5 <pubDate>

recommendation.en: Keep the feed valid: absolute item links that answer 200 and RFC 822 pubDate.
recommendation.tr: Feed'i gecerli tutun: 200 donen mutlak oge baglantilari ve RFC 822 bicimli pubDate.

site.na_when: llms.enabled is false => rule is NOT_APPLICABLE and leaves the denominator
site.pass_condition: all 4 checks pass (or rule is N/A)
site.weight_rationale: llms.txt is a proposal, not a standard; Google states it is not needed. The rule only checks self-consistency, hence the lowest weight.

recommendation.en: If llms.txt is on, serve it as UTF-8 plain text with an H1 on the first line and links that answer 200; otherwise leave it off.
recommendation.tr: llms.txt aciksa UTF-8 duz metin olarak, ilk satirda H1 ile ve 200 donen baglantilarla sunun; acik degilse kapali birakin.

title.en: Resolved page title is not empty

post.note: Title LENGTH is not scored; no official threshold exists (see excluded_rules).

recommendation.en: Give the post a title; the resolved page title is empty.
recommendation.tr: Yaziya bir baslik verin; cozulen sayfa basligi bos.

source.section: Uygulama talimati 1 (og:title) + google-arama/yapisal-veri-article.md Uygulama talimati 2 (headline = visible title)

post.measures: rendered head of the post URL

partial.formula: relative URL => 0.5; more than one canonical => 0

recommendation.en: Output a self-referencing canonical with the post's absolute URL.
recommendation.tr: Yazinin mutlak adresini tasiyan kendine referansli bir canonical basın.

post.measures: head link rel=canonical, Link HTTP header, per-post override

checks.expect: no two different URLs for the same page

post.pass_condition: one method and no conflicting URL
post.na_when: no canonical is output at all (canonical_self already covers it)

recommendation.en: Use one canonical method only: the head tag or the HTTP header, never both, and never two different URLs.
recommendation.tr: Tek bir kanonik yontem kullanin: head etiketi veya HTTP basligi; ikisi birden olmaz ve iki farkli adres gosterilmez.

post.measures: rendered robots meta of the post; robots.txt rules for its path

checks.read: robots.txt rules for the post path

post.note: A meta directive is only read when the URL is crawlable, so both checks are needed together.

recommendation.en: Make the post indexable again: it is currently excluded by a robots directive.
recommendation.tr: Yaziyi yeniden dizinlenebilir yapin; su anda bir robots kurali onu disliyor.

checks.expect: exactly one of Article, BlogPosting or NewsArticle

recommendation.en: Mark the post up with one Article, BlogPosting or NewsArticle node.
recommendation.tr: Yaziyi tek bir Article, BlogPosting veya NewsArticle dugumuyle isaretleyin.

post.measures: Article node of the post JSON-LD

checks.expect: non-empty and equal to the visible title
absolute URL of an existing image
present (@id pointing to the organization node)

recommendation.en: Complete the Article markup with headline, image, author and publisher.
recommendation.tr: Article isaretlemesini headline, image, author ve publisher ile tamamlayin.

title.en: Dates are ISO 8601 with a time zone

post.note: A missing dateModified is not invented; if the content genuinely never changed, datePublished is used.

recommendation.en: Write datePublished and dateModified in ISO 8601 with a time zone.
recommendation.tr: datePublished ve dateModified alanlarini saat dilimli ISO 8601 biciminde yazin.

title.en: Primary category set and used in the URL

post.measures: primary category meta (wpseokit, or _yoast_wpseo_primary_category on import) vs get_permalink()

checks.read: get_permalink() category segment vs term slug

partial.formula: set but not in the permalink => 0.5

post.risk: Changing the primary category changes the post URL. The recommendation must show the 301 that goes with it.

recommendation.en: Pick a primary category; it decides the post URL and the breadcrumb.
recommendation.tr: Bir birincil kategori secin; yazinin adresini ve kirinti navigasyonunu o belirler.

source.section: Uygulama talimati 1 (tek kanonik adres) + google-arama/sitemap.md Uygulama talimati 3 (yalniz tercih edilen adres)

title.en: Post Open Graph set is complete

recommendation.en: Complete the post's Open Graph set: type, title, description, image and the canonical URL.
recommendation.tr: Yazinin Open Graph setini tamamlayin: type, title, description, image ve kanonik adres.

post.measures: BreadcrumbList node of the post JSON-LD

recommendation.en: Add a BreadcrumbList whose items link to pages that answer 200.
recommendation.tr: Ogrenleri 200 donen sayfalara baglanan bir BreadcrumbList ekleyin.
recommendation.target: WPSeoKit > Settings > Schema (theme HTML is separate work)

post.measures: cached sitemap content vs the post's canonical URL and post_modified

checks.read: lastmod for that loc vs dateModified

recommendation.en: Add the post's canonical URL to the sitemap.
recommendation.tr: Yazinin kanonik adresini sitemap'e ekleyin.

contenthealth_overlap.policy: ContentHealth owns content-level checks. WPSeoKit must not re-measure them (no double scoring). Their rows below are explicit NON-rules for WPSeoKit.

shared_touchpoints.rule: ContentHealth registers a term noindex list on wp_robots; WPSeoKit merges its own directive instead of overwriting it.
ContentHealth does not own 404s; not_found_returns_404 is a WPSeoKit rule.

contenthealth_overlap.formula_note: ContentHealth uses a separate penalty model (CAP critical 15 / warning 8 / info 3, WEIGHT 1.5 / 0.8 / 0.3, score = 100 - sum(min(cap, weight * affected percent))). WPSeoKit does not reuse it; the two scores are never summed or converted.

excluded_rules.reason: No official threshold in any knowledge-base document
No threshold document; also a ContentHealth rule
Keyword stuffing is a spam policy with no numeric threshold
No knowledge-base document defines a count

excluded_rules.candidate: duplicate title, long title, featured image

excluded_rules.reason: Only field measurement is valid and the plugin has no field data source; lab data would produce false 'good' verdicts
excluded_rules.lives_in: link to PageSpeed / Search Console (information only)

excluded_rules.reason: Official page gives no numeric weight (DOGRULANMADI)
Google states it is not needed
Responsive theme serves one document for both user agents; nothing to measure

fix_types.one_click: the plugin can change a setting or regenerate output
fix_types.manual: a human must edit content or a template

dismiss_policy.visibility: hidden from the list, listed under 'Dismissed (n); they still count in the score'

score.cap_note.en: A critical rule is failing, so the score is capped at 79 until it is fixed.
score.cap_note.tr: Kritik bir kural kaliyor; duzeltilene kadar skor en fazla 79 olabilir.

score.not_a_guarantee.en: This score is not a ranking guarantee.
score.not_a_guarantee.tr: Bu skor bir siralama garantisi degildir.

score.na_note.en: Not applicable on this site, so it is left out of the calculation.
